signal: CloudBolt acquired StormForge and was named a Leader in the GigaOm Radar for Cloud Management Platforms, doubling down on Augmented FinOps.

email.body1:
Keno, saw CloudBolt acquired StormForge and landed Leader status in GigaOm's Cloud Management Radar.

Moves like that usually surface more in-market accounts than the team can cover before reps are stretched, and that is where deals go cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a signal play for CloudBolt off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Keno, quick follow-up for CloudBolt.

After an acquisition, expectations on pipeline usually jump faster than headcount can, and most teams cannot say exactly how many meetings they need to hit the number. So the gap shows up late, and recovering the quarter turns into a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings CloudBolt needs to close that gap this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Keno, last bit of proof for CloudBolt.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks with every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how CloudBolt's reply rate likely compares to other cloud-software teams. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Keno, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount is not a priority while you integrate StormForge, no problem at all. Timing matters after an acquisition, and I know it keeps a revenue team busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your motion? I will tailor it to CloudBolt either way.
